frequency_question: What proportion of intended liquidity tool implementations successfully map to the precise notification criteria and date bounds?
membership_rule: Members are instances where policy intent for a targeted liquidity ratio tool existed; hits are those formally notified within the exact specified date window, misses are those announced outside the window or via alternative non-matching instruments.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; represents all major instances of incremental reserve/absorption ratio deployments by the RBI in recent decades.
known_gaps: Minor operational adjustments or localized liquidity directives might exist but do not match the formal iCRR nomenclature.
skeleton: Central bank policy announcements of specific liquidity ratios categorized by adherence to exact date and naming constraints.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 3 total similar targeted liquidity instrument announcements in modern RBI history.
validity_reason: Central bank regulatory notification protocols and legal frameworks for reserve ratios remain highly stable over five-year horizons.
